The largest manufacturer of medical equipment and devices in the world by annual revenue is Medtronic, with yearly sales reaching approximately $36.4 billion. Close competitors in the top tier include Johnson & Johnson MedTech, Abbott Laboratories, and Siemens Healthineers. [](https://www.getreskilled.com/medical-device-companies/)

- **Medtronic**: Leader in cardiovascular, neurological, and diabetes tech.

- **Johnson & Johnson MedTech**: Major producer of orthopedics and surgery tools.

- **Abbott Laboratories**: Known for diagnostics and continuous glucose monitors.

- **Medline Industries**: Massive private supplier of basic hospital-surgical goods.

- **Siemens Healthineers**: Dominates large medical imaging systems like MRIs. [](https://www.mddionline.com/business/top-40-medical-device-companies)
